business_problem: Vestiaire Collective needed to remove friction from its fast-growing resale marketplace as rising catalog volume, more authentications, and more orders pushed its legacy platform past the point where it could deliver a smooth customer experience.
solution_summary: Vestiaire Collective refactored core parts of its resale marketplace onto a microservices architecture backed by MongoDB Atlas on AWS. The team wanted a document database that could support a rapidly changing product catalog, new digital services, and a more community-driven experience without forcing engineers to spend their time patching or operating clusters. After developer training, the company migrated five core projects in a matter of hours, including its content management system, product catalog, rule engine manager, and social newsfeed. Atlas became the managed data layer for the new services, giving engineers flexible documents for fast schema evolution and infrastructure-as-code operations for reliable scaling. The new stack reduced delays, supported continuous growth in listings and sales, and gave the team a greener and cheaper platform to run at global marketplace scale.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the product, content, rules, and newsfeed data behind Vestiaire Collective's refactored marketplace services.

solution_components.name: AWS
solution_components.role: Hosts the managed Atlas deployment and surrounding cloud infrastructure for the marketplace modernization.

data_flow: Listings, content, business rules, and community feed events are written into Atlas-backed microservices, those services query the shared product and content data in real time, and the marketplace applications return updated product and community experiences to buyers and sellers across devices.
business_outcome: Vestiaire Collective lowered infrastructure cost and energy use, doubled sales during 2020, and gave its engineering team a scalable foundation for faster customer-facing improvements across its global resale marketplace.
